daily.full:
共識

共同看好相對集中。$AMD 有2個帳號：@aleabitoreddit 分享拋售期間高管評論，包括$AMD 行政總裁表示需求高於供應（原帖），@StockSavvyShay 則把$AMD 放進智能體AI經濟結構討論。$AMZN 同樣2個：@OptionsMike 認為拋售過度、是超大規模雲端中最佳，高於所有均線，272.5歷史高點在望，自己從未賣出仍持有（原帖）。$LITE 有2個，@aleabitoreddit 引$LITE 行政總裁指出需求帳與市場拋售之間存在巨大脫節。$ARM 同$SHOP 亦各有2個看好，後者@TheTranscript_ 提到AI流量年增2.6倍、訂單增長3.3倍。

共同看淡

今日無共同看淡（bear列表為空）。看淡觀點存在，但未形成多帳號共識。

分歧

$NVDA 是最明顯分歧：2個看好、1個看淡。@Mr_Derivatives 直接表示做多$NVDA（原帖），@StockSavvyShay 亦有正面提及；但@OptionsMike 擔心週末壞消息，Jensen 因與中國間諜約會接受調查，股票已破、遠低於200日均線，下方有小缺口待填，雖然盈利會超預期但（原帖）。$INTC 同$NBIS 各有1多1空，@StockSavvyShay 認為$INTC 在相同55美元已成美國先進晶片製造核心，但@TrendSpider 宣佈「歡迎來到第4階段」並針對$INTC $NBIS 等。

其他值得留意

最多人講的是$NVDA（提及11次），其次$AMD（7次）、$MU。整體64帖中，共同共識落在AI需求相關名字，大盤指數討論較少形成單邊。@Beth_Kindig 中性提到Arista預測2027年底跨多種加速器部署超10吉瓦，涵蓋$NVDA $AMD $AVGO。

weekly.brief: 過去7日（03日至09日）有343則帖、64個帳號。共同看好包括$AEHR（4帳號）、$AAPL、$LITE、$APP（各3）。共同看淡集中在$SNDK（4）。分歧最深在$NVDA（4/4）、$MU（1/5）、$ORCL（2/4）。最大變化係光學同測試設備繼續受追捧，$LITE 有帳號認為價值遠超1000美元，而$ORCL 有Stephens目標價上調至213美元但同時受減租消息。
weekly.full:
共識

$AEHR 有4個帳號看好。@ripster47 稱財報強勁符合預期，AI基建交易仍在，只是成長股受大環境拖累。@kevinxu 打趣說他唯一次對財報保持沉默，$AEHR 便上漲約20%。$AAPL 有3個：@MarkNewtonCMT 承認短期動能不穩，但較大趨勢穩健無明顯惡化；@munster_gene 強調12月收入指引優於預期比略軟利潤率更重要。$LITE 有3個，@michaelsikand 認為價值遠超1000美元/股，最大收穫是對光子學整體看漲。$APP 有3個。

共同看淡

$SNDK 有4個看淡。@TrendSpider 宣佈第4階段並針對它，另有選舉相關對AI押注的擔憂。

分歧

$NVDA 4多4空。$MU 1多5空，@TrendSpider 指出支撐已消失。$ORCL 2多4空：@WallStJesus 轉Stephens從平等權重升至超配、目標價從185美元上調至213美元，但@ripster47 指微軟正逐步減少甲骨文租用AI雲端容量並拋售$SOXL。$AMZN 4多1空，$PLTR 3多1空。

其他值得留意

343帖中，光學、測試設備同部分應用層名字有較乾淨共識，指數同記憶體則分歧明顯。$LITE 的1000美元說法同$ORCL 的213目標價是本週明確價位討論。

No common bearish names. Clearest split is on $NVDA (2 bull / 1 bear). The biggest shift is multiple executives pointing to a huge disconnect between AI demand and the market selloff, while @OptionsMike sees the $AMZN selloff as overdone with the 272.5 historical high in sight.
daily.full:
Consensus

Common bullish views are relatively concentrated. $AMD has 2 accounts: @aleabitoreddit shares executive comments during the selloff, including the $AMD CEO saying demand exceeds supply (post), while @StockSavvyShay places $AMD inside the agentic AI economy structure. $AMZN also has 2: @OptionsMike sees the selloff as overdone, calls it the best among hyperscalers, above all moving averages, with the 272.5 historical high in sight, and notes he has never sold and still holds (post). $LITE has 2, with @aleabitoreddit citing the $LITE CEO on the huge disconnect between demand books and the market selloff. $ARM and $SHOP each have 2 bullish accounts; the latter via @TheTranscript_ on AI traffic up 2.6x and orders up 3.3x.

Common Bearish

No common bearish names today (bear list empty). Bearish views exist but have not formed multi-account consensus.

Divergence

$NVDA is the clearest split: 2 bullish, 1 bearish. @Mr_Derivatives states he is long $NVDA (post) and @StockSavvyShay has positive mentions; but @OptionsMike worries about weekend bad news, Jensen under investigation for dating a Chinese spy, stock broken and well below the 200-day moving average with a small gap below to fill, even though earnings will beat and raise guidance but... (post). $INTC and $NBIS each have 1/1; @StockSavvyShay sees $INTC at the same $55 as now central to U.S. advanced chip manufacturing, while @TrendSpider announces “welcome to stage 4” targeting $INTC $NBIS and others.

Other Notes

Most discussed is $NVDA (11 mentions), followed by $AMD (7) and $MU. Of the 64 posts, common consensus sits on AI-demand-related names while index discussion forms less one-sided views. @Beth_Kindig neutrally notes Arista’s prediction of over 10 GW of multi-accelerator deployments by end-2027, covering $NVDA $AMD $AVGO.

Common Bearish

$NVDA is 4 bull / 4 bear. $MU is 1/5, with @TrendSpider noting support has vanished. $ORCL is 2/4: @WallStJesus relays Stephens raising from Equal-Weight to Overweight and lifting the target from $185 to $213, while @ripster47 says Microsoft is gradually reducing AI cloud capacity leased from Oracle and sells $SOXL. $AMZN is 4/1, $PLTR 3/1.

Other Notes

Among 343 posts, optics, test equipment and some application-layer names have cleaner consensus while indices and memory show clear splits. The $LITE $1000+ view and the $ORCL $213 target are the explicit price levels this week.
